title: Boy Idol Male Body Duo #005 · 키 큰 슬렌더 / 클래식 머슬
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright tropical jungle boardwalk of wooden planks with a waist-high rope rail, large green leaves and standard-height steps, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Korean man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, luminous porcelain skin, composed and elegant, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing four to six layered silver earrings. Long oval nails, holographic finish.
LEFT Physique: A very tall, slim, long-limbed man with a runway build. Straight shoulders, a flat lean chest, a flat defined stomach, slender strong arms and very long legs, lightly muscled and elegant, with visible collarbones and a narrow waist. His head stays in correct proportion to his long frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst), wide silver chrome bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense zigzag linework filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Chinese man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, light skin with a warm golden undertone, intense and focused, cool ash-brown hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing four to six layered mixed-metal earrings. Long coffin nails, glossy finish.
RIGHT Physique: A classically muscular athletic man in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful but not exaggerated. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense repeating floral border filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme silver ankle-strap stilettos with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the muscle and flesh fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every muscle and fold. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
